migration.rule: Do not delete legacy labels during the migration window. Remove a label only after local automation, open issues and pull requests, saved-search owners, and known external integrations have been reviewed.

wiki.decision: GitHub Wiki is disabled. Repository documentation is the only normative documentation surface; docs/00-project/NORMATIVE_SOURCES.md defines precedence.

controls.title: At least one active ruleset protects the discovered default branch
Publishing and deployment environments have protection rules
Dependabot alerts and security updates are enabled
CODEOWNERS exists on the reviewed default branch
Squash is the only enabled merge method
GitHub Wiki is disabled in favor of normative repository docs
Issue intake uses the governed GitHub Issue Forms set
